Prince William Launches Suicide Prevention Initiative with Sports Stars

Prince William has launched a new initiative aimed at preventing suicide within the sports sector. The initiative, described as a "lifelong mission," was unveiled on Thursday with the support of several prominent British sporting figures. Among those joining the Prince of Wales were Olympic gold medalists Kelly Holmes, Jason Kenny, and Laura Kenny. The project is intended to guide the sports industry in enhancing its efforts to address suicide prevention.
